page_title: ATA 2-1 CRE | Atalanta v Cremonese 09/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Marco Piccinini is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+4' 2 - 1 Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) meets a perfect cross from Sebastiano Luperto deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the right post. The score is 2:1.
90+4' The goal by Atalanta won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
90+2' The Atalanta players halt their celebrations as referee Marco Piccinini makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+1' Goal! 3:0. The ball rebounds to Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
90+1' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
90+1' The ball goes behind for a corner. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
89' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
89' A brilliant cross into the box finds Milan Djuric (Cremonese), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.

84' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom right corner, but great anticipation by Emil Audero allowed him to make a comfortable save.
84' Substitution. Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) on for Tommaso Barbieri.
82' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make.
82' The corner kick from Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
80' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
79' Cremonese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' A big rebound finds it way to Youssef Maleh (Cremonese), whose attempted long-range shot is almost immediately blocked by one of the opposition players. Cremonese have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Martin Payero (Cremonese). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yunus Musah (Atalanta) will replace Giacomo Raspadori.
76' CHANCE! Ederson finds Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
74' A poor finish by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.

71' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Emil Audero.
71' Milan Djuric (Cremonese) picks up a long through ball, but Marco Carnesecchi deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
70' Here is a change. Lazar Samardzic is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta).
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) coming on for Nicola Zalewski.

66' Ederson (Atalanta) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Emil Audero was ready and made a save.
66' The corner from Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) is hurriedly cleared.
65' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
63' A precise first-time shot by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by a defender.
62' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Jamie Vardy will be replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese).
62' Here comes a substitution. Alberto Grassi is given a rest as he is replaced by Martin Payero (Cremonese).
62' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
61' Ederson (Atalanta) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
60' What a big chance! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.
59' Substitution. Davide Zappacosta makes his way off the pitch and Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) comes on as his replacement.
58' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Sead Kolasinac is replaced by Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta).

58' A long cross into the middle of the area is pounced on by Morten Thorsby (Cremonese), but his header curls narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
57' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
56' Marco Piccinini couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) and blew his whistle.
54' The players claim that Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
51' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

51' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Marco Piccinini didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' Emil Audero leaps to intercept the corner kick from Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta).
49' Ederson (Atalanta) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Atalanta get a corner.
48' Atalanta take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
48' A cross into the box from Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) is cleared. Atalanta win a corner.
48' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

48' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. The linesman makes the right call and Atalanta will have a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Davide Nicola decided to make a change. Federico Bonazzoli is replaced by Milan Djuric (Cremonese).
46' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
43' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
42' The total number of attempts is 13:2.
39' Davide Nicola is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Federico Ceccherini suffers an injury and Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) comes on.
38' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
37' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
36' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.

32' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
30' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Piccinini interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
28' He should have scored! Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.

25' 2 - 0 Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Emil Audero is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:0.
24' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Nicola Zalewski, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
23' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
21' What a chance that is! Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
18' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle after Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
13' 1 - 0 Giacomo Raspadori plays a terrific cross over to Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta), who finds some space inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
11' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

10' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom right corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. Now Atalanta have a corner.
10' Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.

9' A loose ball is pounced on by Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the top of the net, but Emil Audero is alert and makes a comfortable save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' The resulting corner from Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
8' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta). Atalanta earn a corner.
6' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
4' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

4' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Cremonese will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marco Piccinini.
